title: An All-Fangs Meeting for Vampires
subtitle: Cyber Security issues are more important for blood sucking vampires than they imagined
text:
The Frontier Psychiatrists is a daily health themed newsletter. Today, a palette cleansing sorbet of an article.

I've got bad news. Everybody, gather around. There has been… I don't even know how I'm going to say this.

Q.

I mean, I guess you're right, with a seductive lilt in my voice, and a slight Transylvania accent is probably the best way to do it.

If I were living, I'd take a deep breath. You never know how much you'll miss those deep breaths as the undead until they don't matter anymore. It feels like nothing matters for eternity.

“…”

OK, so here's the status update. And I warn you, this is about as pleasant as garlic and sticking your hand in a bucket of holy water.

You've heard of change healthcare?

Q.

OK, you haven't heard of Change Healthcare? You've heard of private equity, though?

Q.

Yes, As the drinking of the blood of the unsuspecting human flock is the vampires, sucking money out of otherwise good and decent businesses is to private equity.

Q.

It’s been a very profitable business model for the investors. Keep in mind—it’s not their money. They are paid 2% per year to invest that money for large pension funds. Their job is to find “opportunities” they can take total control over. Yes, much like our seductive gaze is very compelling. Sometimes the general partners have to use some of their own, so they have “blood in the game.”

“…”

It’s like we had a seductive gaze that took 51% control of someone. And every subsequent decision was a majority vote.

Q.

Well once you have 51%, consent becomes… how do I put this? It becomes a “nice to have.”

“…”

Well, then they fire you, if you disagree.

Q.

Someone always agrees. You can be replaced. Next question.

Q.

They can always find the physician who cares less. That is a fact of life, like our dislike of garlic is a fact of death. The prohibition of the corporate practice of medicine is a lot like a Daylight. Yes, of course we're not supposed to walk outside in the daylight, we are creatures of the night. But the sparkle update? That really changed things for us. The prohibition on daylight became a strong recommendation, with limited enforcement. And the same is true for private equity firms that acquire other firms in an attempt to subsequently sell that collection of other firms to another party. It's a little bit like a hamburger— it could be a number of different animals, mashed up together. This is why we like to drink single source plasma, do you want to know where the blood is coming from. But if you imagine that all the blood products we consumed were made of mixture of blood, you can see how that would get pretty splattered pretty quickly. Clotting issues, and the financial equivalent.

Q.

Yeah, they never saw it coming. It was like a seduction! At first, everyone was just making money, they bought one company, then they bought another, and as they did so, the blood was sucked out of one and pumped into another.

Q.

No, not literally. Figuratively. I know! It sounded pretty appealing!

Q.

Well imagine if every human you ever suck the blood from contained a record of your entire bloodline, and would allow the vampire hunters to come after you and stake your heart? In this analogy, the blood is protected health information, and your bloodline, I'm actually getting confused. It's a very confusing problem.

Q.

They know who all of us are, and they're coming for us.

Q.

I am similarly concerned. I am assured that if we pay the ransom, the consequences will be mitigated.

Q.

Instead of a stake through the heart, they use holy water if you pay the ransom.

The Frontier Psychiatrists is a reader-supported publication. This is the 601st article written on a mostly daily basis
